outline: This course will introduce the mathematical principles in engineering, including following topics: First-Order ODEs, Second-Order Linear ODEs, Higher Order Linear ODEs, Systems of ODEs, Series Solutions of ODEs, and Laplace Transforms.
schedule:
1	Course introduction & Review. Basic Concepts of First-Order ODEs.
2	Separable ODEs & Exact ODEs.
3	Linear ODEs & Existence and Uniqueness of Solutions for Initial Value Problems.
4	Homogeneous Linear ODEs of Second Order.
5	In-class Quiz 1 & Homogeneous Linear ODEs with Constant Coefficients & Euler–Cauchy Equations.
6	Existence and Uniqueness of Solutions & Nonhomogeneous ODEs.
7	Homogeneous Linear ODEs & Homogeneous Linear ODEs with Constant Coefficients.
8	Nonhomogeneous Linear ODEs.
9	Systems of ODEs as Models in Engineering Applications & Mid-term Exam.
10	Power Series Method.
11	Legendre’s Equation & Extended Power Series Method.
12	Bessel’s Equation & General Solution of Bessel Functions.
13	In-class quiz 2 & Laplace Transform.
14	Transforms of Derivatives and Integrals & Unit Step Function.
15	Differentiation and Integration of Transforms & Laplace Transform: General Formulas.
16	Review & Final Exam.
17	Flexible Learning (see Note).
18	Flexible Learning (see Note).
assessment:
Subject Mark =
Attendance 10% +
